children: Titan Company is looking to ramp up watch retail chain network to 500 stores by 2030 under Helios and Helios Luxe. This comes as the company has been strengthening its focus on premium and luxury watch segments. Also, the premium price points segments in the watch market are witnessing strong growth.

Rahul Shukla, Vice President and Chief Sales & Marketing Officer, Watches Division, Titan Company Ltd told businessline, “Every year we have been adding 30-40 stores. So at this pace of expansion, we would have close to 500 stores of Helios , out of which 40-50 will be Helios Luxe stores.”

On Friday, two new stores of Helios Luxe were launched in the Delhi-NCR region, taking the total count of the luxury watch boutiques to 16 across the country. Shukla said by the end of the year, the company expects to operating 25-30 Helios Luxe boutiques. Helios and Helios Luxe registered 35 per cent growth in the first half of the fiscal year.

Shukla pointed out that the watch market is witnessing strong growth in the segment priced above ₹25,000.  “Helios and Helios Luxe are well-positioned to participate in this structural shift in the market, as evolving consumers are increasingly willing to uptrade, explore premium brands and seek differentiation. Helios and Helio Luxe are growing faster than category growth rates. Helios has been growing at 51 per cent and Helios Luxe has growning at 95 per cent,” he added.
While Helios stores offer products between ₹25,000 to about ₹1 lakh, Helios Luxe operates in the price point range of about ₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh.

Shukla pointed out that Helios Luxe has also inked exclusive partnership with nine international brands over the last 24 months to build a strong portfolio. “With an expanding national footprint, a growing portfolio of distinctive watchmakers and a stronger focus on storytelling, Helios Luxe is looking to shape the next chapter of premium and luxury watch retail in India,” he noted.

title: Titan looks to ramp up watch retail network to 500 stores
